verdict.rationale: Devin has a documented API, and its CLI has a permission system for MCP tools, but nothing in the evidence shows issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials. The create_as_user_id parameter and the tool-permission controls are adjacent features, not credential scoping, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
